about: Sainte-Agathe-des-Monts is a city in the Laurentians, Quebec, on Lac des Sables northwest of Montréal. A classic Laurentian resort town, it mixes a lakeside village centre with surrounding ski hills, bike paths, and cottage country. About 10,000 people live in Sainte-Agathe-des-Monts.
seoSummary: Laurentian lakeside city on Lac des Sables—resort town, village centre, and cottage country northwest of Montréal.
